questions.description: Questions to ask the user (1-4), shown as one card with a step per question

question.description: The complete question to ask, ending with a question mark

header.description: Very short label shown as a chip (max 12 characters)

type.description: single: pick one option; multi: pick between min and max options; text: free-text answer only (no options); yes_no: Yes or No (no options)

options.description: The choices (2-6) for single and multi questions. Omit for text and yes_no

label.description: Short display text of the option (1-5 words)

description.description: What choosing this option means or implies

recommended.description: Mark the option you suggest; it is shown first and highlighted. At most one for single questions

min.description: multi only: the fewest choices the user must make (default 0)

max.description: multi only: the most choices the user can make (default: all)

allowOther.description: Offer a free-text "Other" answer next to the options (default true). Set to false only when no answer outside the options makes sense
